question: Should this provider-boundary change require redacted live LiteLLM-to-Anthropic cache-forwarding and cache-usage proof before merge?
rationale: The branch’s tests establish OpenClaw payload construction, but only a real proxy/backend run can establish forwarding and the observed cache behavior for the configured route.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a reproducible live transcript showing forwarded `cache_control` and Anthropic cache creation/read results before merge.

options.title: Accept deterministic payload proof
options.body: Merge based on the explicit capability gate and regression tests while maintainers intentionally own the remaining LiteLLM forwarding uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical bug
options.body: Keep the linked bug as the active tracker until a testable LiteLLM-to-Anthropic environment is available.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a reproducible live transcript showing forwarded `cache_control` and Anthropic cache creation/read results before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider-proof sufficiency decision, and the available history connects this person to adjacent live provider validation work.
